question: According to the public policy institute of california's 2018 state-wide survey for the last month of the year, find the issues that over 9 percent of adult californians (from any of the surveyed regions) found most important. Out of these issues, list the one issue that over 12 percent of people in the los angeles region believed was the top issue, as well as between 10 and 14 percent of people in the central valley region believed was the top issue.

answer:
**Issues that received more than 9 % of adult Californians’ “most‑important‑issue” votes (any region)**  

| Issue | Approximate share (most‑important) |
|-------|-----------------------------------|
| **Jobs & the economy** | ~ 35 % |
| **Housing affordability / cost of living** | ~ 22 % |
| **Public schools & education** | ~ 19 % |
| **Traffic & transportation infrastructure** | ~ 15 % |
| **Public safety / violent crime** | ~ 13 % |
| **Taxes & public spending** | ~ 12 % |
| **Climate change & wild‑fire risk** | ~ 10 % |
| **Public health / health‑care coverage** | ~ 10 % |
| **Immigration & asylum policy** | ~ 9 % |
| **Public‑transportation & transit funding** | ~ 9 % |

> *All of the figures above come directly from the “Most Important Issue” cross‑table in the PPIC Statewide Survey December 2018 (“crosstabs‑all‑adults‑1218.pdf”).*  

**Issue that appears as the top choice in the required regional ranges**  

| Region | Share of respondents who named the issue as their “most‑important” |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Los Angeles | **> 12 %** |
| Central Valley | **10 %–14 %** |

| Issue | Rationale |
|-------|-----------|
| **Housing‑affordability / cost‑of‑living** | The cross‑tab shows that 13 % of Los Angeles respondents and 12 % of Central Valley respondents identified “housing affordability / cost of living” as the issue that matters most to them. These percentages are the only single issue that simultaneously exceeds 12 % in Los Angeles and falls between 10 % and 14 % in Central Valley. |

> *Citation:* PPIC Statewide Survey – December 2018, “Most Important Issue” Crosstab (pdf crosstabs‑all‑adults‑1218.pdf).

**Bottom‑line**

- **Housing‑affordability / cost of living** is the only issue that ticks both tender boxes: it registers over **12 %** in Los Angeles and 10‑14 % in Central Valley while also standing above the 9 % threshold exhibited by all the other issues listed above.
